resources.string: Ifayela elilandiwe lonakele. I-checksum yalo ayihambisani. Zama ukulanda futhi.
Ukulanda akusebenzanga. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
Ayikho indawo eyanele yokugcina kudivayisi yakho. Khulula indawo kuqala.
Ukuxhumana kumile ngesikhathi sokulanda. Cindezela Qalisa kabusha ukuze uqhubeke.
Ithebula lamakhodi ezimpande ezinhlamvini ze-Hanzi, izinhlamvu ezingama-29,000. Ikhibhodi idinga leli phakethe lezinhlelo ze-Cangjie ne-Quick.
Ukufundwa kwe-Kana okuvela ku-mozc, okufakiwe okuyizigidi eziyi-1.08, cishe ama-42 MB. Ikhibhodi idinga leli phakethe ukuze iguqule isiJapane.
Ithebula lokufundwa kwe-Jyutping ezinhlamvini ze-Hanzi, okufakiwe okungu-163,000. Ikhibhodi idinga leli phakethe ukuze iguqule isi-Cantonese.
Izinhlamvu ze-Hanzi nemishwana evela ku-CC-CEDICT, okufakiwe okungu-120,000. Ikhibhodi idinga leli phakethe ukuze iguqule isiShayina.
Ithebula lokuhleleka kwemivimbo yezinhlamvu zesi-Hanzi. Ikhibhodi idinga leli phakethe lesakhiwo semivimbo.
